utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's tomorrow, 10 a.m. at the community center. I'm glad you're coming, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Tomorrow at 10? Right, I'll put it in my phone... if I can find my phone. And I'll try to dig up that wrench!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Every bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What time does the repair drive start tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, sweetheart, I’m so sorry—the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center, not tomorrow. Starts at 10 AM sharp!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, Sunday 10 AM at the community center. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, is it cool if I just drop off my broken toaster tomorrow morning, or do you need me to stick around?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh sure, you can drop it off! We'll have a labeled bin near the pickup zone, and the volunteers will grab it when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll swing by at 9 then. Thanks, Faye!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I've got my tool kit ready to go— figured I'd bring it over and see what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Gus! The supplies are still by the old oak tree. You can set up there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I'll head over soon and start sorting through what folks have brought.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm planning to attend the repair drive on Saturday. I like to have a clear schedule for these events.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh Eli, I think there's been a change — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, that throws my whole Saturday plan off. I'll need to adjust my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive? We're getting it all sorted out, and it's going to be fantastic!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I did hear it got moved to Sunday at the community center—hope everyone got the memo, I'm a bit worried about the supply situation.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh don't you worry, Pia! I've been chatting with Cleo and she's bringing in a truckload of supplies—we'll be set!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, that's the spot! We'll be there from 9 AM till whenever we finish—bring anything you want fixed!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good to know the time—I'll bring my wobbly chair. Is it still at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, same place — the old community center on Maple. See you there with that chair!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! I think I need some screws... or was it bolts? Let me check my list—I might have left it at home again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do you remember what item you were planning to fix? I can help you figure out if it needs screws or bolts once we know the specifics.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, it was that old rocking chair on my porch... or maybe it was the garden gate? I really should start writing these things down.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm glad you're here, Sam. Do you have a spare screwdriver or anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I've got a whole toolbox in my garage. Let me grab it for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam. I think Oren might need a wrench too—he mentioned losing his.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, I'm organizing a repair drive this Saturday morning at the community center. Are you free to help out?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, hey Vik! Sorry I'm late—yeah, I think I can make it Saturday morning. What exactly do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great! I'm gathering tools and volunteers for the repair drive this Saturday morning. We'll need help fixing shelves, painting, and cleaning up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds great! I'll meet you at the sign-up table later. Can't pass up cookies and community help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect! I'll save you a spot — and maybe we can grab some of those cookies together before we start fixing things.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like a plan! Can't wait to dig into those cookies and then get our hands dirty.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure who's running it, but my toaster still clicks like it's trying to tap out a message.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So it sounds like the repair drive's all talk and no fix, huh?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, it's just noise and no action, like a broken record.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? It's a great way to meet people from the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is actually going to fix anything, Jules? I've seen too many promises fall through.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I know what you mean, Kira, but Vik's really got it organized this time—Gus is bringing his tool kit, and I've even roped in Dane from the other side of the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I could help you set up a schedule, if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's kind of you, Rey. But the drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center now—I'm just worried everyone will show up at the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that's a relief it's still on, but the location change might really confuse folks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can bring my toolbox and help fix things up!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, Sam! Just remember it's at 9 AM tomorrow. Gotta run!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, 9 AM tomorrow. I'll be there with my toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Cleo, have you heard about the repair drive? I keep getting mixed reports on what it's actually for.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The repair drive is all about fixing up damaged community items—tools, furniture, that sort of thing. The supplies are by the old oak tree if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, so it's for fixing stuff? I thought it was something else—good to know, maybe I'll finally get that squeaky chair looked at.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, you're just the person I need to see! There's a repair drive this Saturday — we're all getting together to fix broken stuff around the neighborhood. You in?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A repair drive? Sounds... familiar. I think I wrote it down somewhere, but then my pen ran out of ink.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, I've got a pen right here — let me write down the details for you again!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I just confirmed with Cleo that the repair drive is still by the old oak tree, so that's where I'm heading.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that's perfect, Opal! The old oak tree is right along the school pickup route, so parents can easily drop by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, so it's super convenient for everyone. I'll head over there now to get started.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, yeah, I'm planning to come to the repair drive—just a bit late as usual. Save a spot for me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, sure, I'll save you a spot... wait, where exactly is this repair drive happening again?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It's at the community center parking lot, near the old oak tree.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I heard about it. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great! I'm planning to gather tools and volunteers for the repair drive this Saturday morning. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I'll be there with my old toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got my tool kit ready to go, plus that old drill I fixed up—should be handy for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great, Gus! I heard Opal say the drive might be further down the street now, so we should double-check the location before heading out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good call, Ira. I'll swing by Opal's place on my way over and make sure we're all set on the spot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Are we still on for 9 AM?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Actually, Leo, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, not 9 AM at my place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What time Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll be there, Vik. I've got my tools ready and I'm planning to help with the furniture repairs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Eli, that's wonderful! With your tools and my know-how, we'll have this repair drive running smoother than my old station wagon after a good tune-up!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Tess, I like the sound of that. Let's stick to a schedule so nothing gets overlooked.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just a heads up, Mina, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, Sunday? Why the change—did somebody finally realize how cramped that porch would be?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You hit the nail on the head, Mina! The community center just gives us so much more room to spread everything out and work comfortably.
